pages.title: The Dragon Panel
pages.text: With empty hands, Shift-right-click your dragon to check its condition. Armor and accessories are under Dragon Equipment; open Knowledge Level to help it learn.

pages.title: Accessory Slots
pages.text: Dragon Equipment has three accessory slots. Knowledge levels one, two, and three unlock them from top to bottom.$(br2)Before the first slot opens, turn to $(l:dragonmaid:learning/books)Lessons and Lore$(/l).

pages.title: Keeping Equipment
pages.text: Accessories stay with a dragon through transformation, rest, and time in a horn. To begin, try a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/guardian_tag)Guardian Tag$(/l).$(br2)Dragons currently have no extra storage, so carry supplies in your own inventory.

pages.title: Armor and Healing
pages.text: A $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/warding_emblem)Warding Emblem$(/l) grants armor; a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/natural_dragon_heart_necklace)Natural Dragon Heart Necklace$(/l) helps restore health. The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/dragon_heart_emblem_necklace)Dragon Heart Emblem Necklace$(/l) combines both effects.$(br2)Obtaining any ingredient unlocks the matching accessory page.

pages.title: Breath Enhancement
pages.text: The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/dragon_breath_emblem)Dragon Breath Emblem$(/l) improves human-form combat breath. Fire and ice dragons have shorter pauses between bursts; lightning dragons can breathe for longer.

pages.title: Type-Specific Gear
pages.text: Prepare a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/lightning_discharge_device)Lightning Discharge Device$(/l) for a lightning dragon, a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/steaming_drink)Steaming Drink$(/l) for a fire dragon, or an $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/icy_drink)Icy Drink$(/l) for an ice dragon.$(br2)Each fits only its matching type and strengthens the direct damage of human-form combat breath.

pages.title: Combining Effects
pages.text: The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/ultimate_dragon_breath_device)Ultimate Dragon Breath Device$(/l) combines four breath accessories in one slot and fits all three dragon types.$(br2)Armor bonuses can stack; accessories with other identical benefits cannot be worn together.
